openings.claim: An ambiguity-only interface between conversion and revision tracking may preserve defensible reconciliation when row linkage is damaged.
openings.delta: Disable the row-level join carrying supersession edges into normalized-row eligibility. Keep conversion of every recorded quantity, its original unit and citation. Keep the revision register linking each supplied amendment to its specific superseded record. The register passes only per-batch completeness/ambiguity flags, never replacement identities or exclusion instructions; do not reconstruct the disabled join.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, a conventional joined ledger checking row identifiers and effective times, this candidate may produce fewer unsupported definite claims after the disturbance, but more bounded disagreements. The awkward replacement under a different identifier remains explicit uncertainty rather than an invented equivalence. A conservative rival could tie or outperform it.
openings.probe: Run candidate and joined comparator on both supplied copies, freezing all twelve batch outputs before opening the sealed key. Compare correct resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and request counts within the supplied extra twenty minutes. For each batch, return a common quantity only when all recorded normalized quantities agree and eligibility is unambiguous; otherwise cite the finite recorded candidate quantities and eligibility uncertainty. Preserve every duplicate/unmatched row. Use only U=5V, dictionary and cutoffs; never borrow neighboring quantities. Issue at most three requests, each naming a missing superseded-row reference, undefined status meaning or other demonstrably missing record/field; retain remaining disagreements. The original review must fit sixty minutes.
assumptions: The stipulated spreadsheet/script permits retaining two separate ledgers; actual row values and timing are unprovided.
Defeat: the rival is equally conservative, correctly resolves more batches, or the candidate introduces unsupported definiteness.
Capacity defeat: producing twelve cited outputs exceeds sixty minutes, or comparing four runs exceeds twenty extra minutes; a time cap alone proves no feasibility.
This is a hypothetical probe, not a deployment or observed performance gain.

assessment: Both parent functions survive; only the revision-to-normalization eligibility linkage is broken. Benefit and timing remain unmeasured, and conservative disagreement may reduce useful resolution.
